original_scenario: CUTLASS block-scaled GEMM on Blackwell SM100-class devices
relationship: Our CUDA is an independent Thor SM110 SIMT correctness baseline plus shared-tile candidate; it retains explicit group scale placement and omits CuTe/UMMA/Tensor Core machinery.
limitations: GitHub page was readable, but no local checkout or CUDA build was available. CUTLASS main currently documents other architectures; no SM110 support claim is inferred.
